title: Ghost Ship of Bones
description: A surreal seascape depicts a large ghostly sailing ship with blue eyes in its sails and hull floating above a sea made of skeletal remains and shipwrecks. In the twilight sky above, a giant blue human eye watches over the scene, surrounded by floating bubbles, torn paper fragments, and small birds.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene at dusk showing a majestic ghost ship with blue eyes embedded in its white sails and hull sailing upon a sea of bones and shipwreck debris. A giant realistic blue human eye floats in the cloudy twilight sky above, surrounded by transparent bubbles, torn parchment pieces, and small black birds. Decaying frame border with peeling texture, dreamlike atmosphere, intricate details.
